Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer clicked into and proceeded to analyze the scikit-learn 0.18 (September 2016) release notes instead of the July 2017 changelog. This wrong source selection led to summarizing irrelevant content and ultimately extracting the incorrect bug-fix target (“RidgeCV”) rather than the correct predictor base command (“BaseLabelPropagation”). The error stemmed from failing to verify the version/date context before drawing conclusions.
